objective: Find a sixth traceable edge that adds return beyond the current portfolio and survives transfer between two consumer-staples equities.
hypothesis: Large consumer-staples equities exhibit persistent medium-term trends and temporary price/oscillator pullbacks; a next-open long entry after a pullback can capture recovery without relying on ambiguous D1 stop-entry sequencing.
falsifier: Reject the family if no frozen PEP representative remains profitable after whole-share stress costs on both PEP and untuned KO validation, or if sealed 2024 OOS and the incremental portfolio benchmark fail.
selection: Freeze at most five structurally distinct PEP train representatives before any validation; no ranking may use KO, validation, OOS, or portfolio results.

portfolio_gate.must_improve: active CAGR versus SPY buy-and-hold after stress costs without exceeding the current portfolio drawdown budget

prohibitions: No parameter or gate relaxation after train results.
No leverage before standalone and incremental portfolio gates pass.
